notes:
Neko Notes is now on Windows! 🐱 Cute sticky notes for your desktop, with a cat who lives on your taskbar.

- Sticky notes that stay on your desktop, or pin them above every window
- Cute backgrounds, transparency, fonts, bold, italic, colours, bullets and round checklists
- Pomodoro timer on any note
- Collapse a note into a little cat head; double-click to open it again
- Pick your cat: Mishu (black, yellow eyes) or Chulli (white, blue eyes, pink paws)
- Click to meow, drag to carry, wiggle your mouse for a belly rub
- Meows before your Google Calendar or Outlook events
- Ctrl+Alt+N new note · Ctrl+Alt+H hide/show all · Ctrl+Alt+M show/hide your cat
- Updates itself from now on
